svg.title: The FK lives on the many side
svg.desc: Customers linked one-to-many to orders with the crow's foot and the foreign key drawn on the orders side. Below, a direct many-to-many link between orders and products is crossed out in red because there is nowhere to put the key, and redrawn with an order_items junction table holding the composite primary key plus quantity and unit price. Three side boxes give the rules for money, time and status columns.
svg.text: The FK lives on the many side
the FK always lives on the MANY side
the junction row carries data of its own - qty, and the
ADD COLUMN + DEFAULT 577 ms · backfill 1M rows 62.7 s · SET NOT NULL 2.0 s · CREATE INDEX 549.6 ms vs CONCURRENTLY 611.6 ms
